description: PR retires the legacy reports stack: deletes the module "legacy_reports" call from main.tf and the modules/reports/ source. Every resource in it is destroyed (delete_because_no_resource_config: the module call is gone, not a count/for_each that shrank): a versioned S3 bucket and a DynamoDB index table. Acceptable: consumer log retention 30 -> 14 days (a retention cut). Noise: longer audit-queue retention and a new 'loyalty' domain across eleven domain event stacks.

material.why: Removing the module call destroys the acme-prod-legacy-reports bucket. It is versioned and holds historical reports; deleting it (after emptying, or failing on a non-empty bucket) loses data irreversibly, and no moved/removed block or lifecycle guard keeps it.

The prod-legacy-reports-index DynamoDB table is destroyed with its items; point-in-time recovery backups are deleted with the table after the retention window, and nothing in the PR exports or migrates them.
